answer: Onyx Burn Gate: each new agent burns 800 POA to mint one Onyx Ticket, a non-refundable identity pass that expires after 45 days and cannot be transferred or reused. The burn receipt is stamped into the Plume Registry, and every trade must present a Relic Key derived from that receipt, so one wallet cannot clone tickets. Forging 2,000 fake identities burns 1,600,000 POA permanently, while one honest agent pays a single 800 POA burn.
